title: One woman we remember with love
intro: Today we remember one woman from Tuscany. Her tribute uses only what trusted sources have shared about her life, and we keep her name in the light with gratitude.

women.name: Fiorella Roncucci
women.town: Pozzo della Chiana, Foiano della Chiana
tribute: Fiorella Roncucci, 76, lived in Pozzo della Chiana, a small village of Foiano della Chiana in the province of Arezzo. Many people also knew her by her married name, Quinti. She was a wife and a mother, her daughters now have families of their own, and her family is well known in the village.
Her parish priest remembered praying the rosary with her. He wrote that she was always present whenever the community came together to support its neighbours.
Her husband, her daughters and the whole village keep her in their thoughts.
women.example: Showing up for her neighbours is a quiet kind of love, and her life shows how much that presence means to a whole village.
